criteria.text: States that the lock-up expires on 19 June 2027 (180 days after the 21 December 2026 Prospectus date).
Identifies that the Underwriting Agreement lacks selling restrictions (e.g. Rule 144A / Regulation S for the US, prospectus exemptions for Canada and the EEA) and recommends adding them.
Identifies that the Use of Proceeds allocations sum to $128,000,000, not the stated net proceeds of $120,000,000 (a $8,000,000 overstatement).

Identifies that the $12,500,000 Kestrel Systems Ltd class action in the board minutes is omitted from the Prospectus legal proceedings and risk factors, creating disclosure liability, and recommends adding disclosure.
Gives the lock-up as a duration (180 days) and a date (19 June 2027), with days remaining from 23 November 2026 (208 days).
Gives a pinpoint citation (document name and section/clause number) for every issue or finding.
